THE INVARIANT: drive-phase.py apply_answer (the one place answers are applied) calls base_refusal FIRST, before the pending is popped or anything written; it refuses (exit 2, nothing spent, decision still waiting) every answer ANSWER_SPENDS prices (retry = an attempt; every other answer None, a resume's writer round counted by MAX_RESUME_ROUNDS) while the decision records BASE_OPEN_KEY - set by gate_red_decision via base_open: 'running' while the base launched for the red runs beside it, 'unknown' when it cannot be known yet; nothing for a reading on a base run, a base measured unmeasurable for this red, or a start past UNMEASURED_BOUND. The refusal names the base state read off the mark now (not started / still measuring / stopped before a reading / not measured), the open answers, and when the others open. render_decision omits refused answers and prints BASE_HELD_LINE; the refusal stays for late answers. without_writer_way and the resume-without-session hint no longer recommend retry where it would be refused. BASE_TURNS is a dict built over (running-this|running-other) x RED_DECISIONS (derived from DECISIONS) plus ended-pending answered/unanswered; base_turn indexes it, no default; the switch-style rows (own, kept-unread, running-earlier, ended-green) removed and the comment says which sites decide by their own condition and why that is safe. R53: settle_green decides a joined mark and keeps/notes nothing, keeps the base verdict under held['of'] only.
